differences: The file labels groups AV, PV, ANV, PNV and 24H; the paper calls groups 2 and 4 'rest' (RV, RNV). The file has 73 participants because the paper's 75 includes one person each from groups 3 and 4 excluded for touchscreen problems; the excluded people are not in the deposit.

Two printed group means did not reproduce within the paper's rounding and are not used as checks: the rest-vision group's visual retention is 36.58 mm from the file (paper: 36.5 mm) and the 24H group's visual recalibration is 38.84 mm from the file (paper: 38.3 mm).
Handedness 'right' is from the Methods (all participants right-handed), not a per-person column.
